warnings: igaL (on iaaL) can slide 7.2 mm (-axis -y) until igaL touches hwL; after 7.0 mm it is out of mesh with gfL and the drive stops. Nothing holds it there; straight teeth do not push it, but side loads on the wheels can walk it along the axle. Close the gap with a bush or move a part so it stops the cluster.

battery, bplL is held to bbrL by a single row of 6 studs, which works like a hinge: bending about the row peels the studs one by one (worst design load 0.87 x strength). Use a wider joint (two rows) or brace it.

battery2, bplR is held to bbrR by a single row of 6 studs, which works like a hinge: bending about the row peels the studs one by one (worst design load 0.87 x strength). Use a wider joint (two rows) or brace it.
hxR55, hxR71, hvR form a linkage of single-pin joints that can rack (e.g. a pinned parallelogram): only pin friction keeps the shape. Add a diagonal brace or a second pin in one of the joints.
hxL55, hxL71, hvL form a linkage of single-pin joints that can rack (e.g. a pinned parallelogram): only pin friction keeps the shape. Add a diagonal brace or a second pin in one of the joints.
